outcome.reason: Customer disputes a transaction of Rs 12,000 and requests investigation before making payment.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?

Thank you for confirming. I’m calling regarding your Mumbai Bank account. I’d like to inform you that a minimum payment of Rs 4,820 was due on 2026-10-15 and has not been received yet. 

Could you please let me know when you will be able to make this payment?
Wait a minute, I want to talk about a transaction of Rs 12,000 first. I never made that payment, so why is it showing up on my account? I’m not paying anything until you investigate that properly.

Thank you for letting me know about your concern. I understand you are disputing a transaction of Rs 12,000 on your account. I will record this dispute and arrange for a human agent to contact you to discuss and resolve this issue.

You do not need to make any payment until your concern has been addressed. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
